dos.text: Slot content as direct, unslotted children, despite the JSDoc's "@slot content" label, the actual template only renders an unnamed default slot (id="content-slot" for accordion cards, bare <slot> otherwise), so adding slot="content" to children keeps them from rendering at all.

donts.text: Don't pass a headingLevel outside 1-6 expecting an error, headingTextTemplate() falls back silently to a plain <span> via `headingLevels[this.headingLevel] || headingLevels[0]`, so a typo like headingLevel="7" just loses heading semantics with no warning.
